findings.passage: When a person votes at a polling place in Indiana, they must show photo ID. Do you support or oppose requiring people to include an ID number (such as their driver’s license number) when they submit an application to vote by mail?
findings.note: Question 5 in his 2022 constituent survey (headed 'State Senator Brian Buchanan'; 'my mailed and online survey'). The results page shows 84% support and 16% oppose among Senate District 7 respondents. These are constituents' answers, not his own stated position. The survey shows he asked constituents about a mail-ballot ID number.
